original_scan_witnesses.name: IMG_4969.jpg
original_scan_witnesses.review_summary: Sign spill 1.5 degrees yields 5 percent; decan spill 30 arcminutes and degree spill 3 arcminutes. First/last wording and preview anecdote do not settle full before/after weights or retrograde timing.

original_scan_witnesses.name: IMG_4971.jpg
original_scan_witnesses.review_summary: Original retains Austin MC 10:57 Aquarius Spark/Pisces FCA and Mars 5:56 Pisces Spark/Aries FCA. Mars is four arcminutes before 6, conflicting with stated three-arcminute width; parity contradiction survives.

original_scan_witnesses.name: IMG_5021.JPG
original_scan_witnesses.review_summary: The horary example explicitly labels Virgo Ascendant4:26 an Aquarius Spark. Sign parity reproduces Aquarius, while literal first-house parity gives Leo. This is a further sign-parity example, not formal precedence over original235.

original_scan_witnesses.name: IMG_5655.JPG
original_scan_witnesses.review_summary: Appendix Alchemystic Degree Theory expressly uses odd signs retaining the Aries sequence and even signs flipping to a Libra start and Pisces end. This is a normative glossary witness for sign parity; it supplies no explicit erratum overriding original235 house wording.

original_scan_witnesses.name: IMG_5680.JPG
original_scan_witnesses.review_summary: Appendix Spark defines the degree as ignition and activation through Pulse and Tone, without giving a new parity procedure. The same page separately names a solar Sophia Arc; it must not be substituted for the lunar mean/true Sophia arc.

original_scan_witnesses.name: IMG_4653.jpg
